We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.


About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Engineering Productivity & Operations to lead how our engineering organisation builds, delivers and operates the Maia platform. You'll own the strategy and execution behind our engineering productivity agenda, including the evolution of our software development lifecycle towards an increasingly agentic model, alongside the operational disciplines that keep engineering efficient: metrics, reporting, cloud and tooling spend, and vendor management. Working closely with engineering leaders across the business and with Finance, you'll lead a team spanning developer experience, release engineering and CloudOps, and have real scope to shape the role and make it your own.

lists.content:
• Setting and leading the engineering productivity strategy, driving the move towards an agentic software delivery model across planning, coding, testing, review and deployment.

  • Owning the roadmap for shared engineering platforms and delivery capabilities, including CI/CD, release automation, observability and the developer experience.

  • Running the engineering operating rhythm and a trusted metrics framework, giving leadership clear visibility of delivery, quality, reliability and cost.

  • Leading engineering FinOps and cloud cost optimisation, working with your CloudOps analysts to build forecasting, accountability and sustainable savings.

  • Managing the engineering tooling portfolio end to end, including vendor evaluation, contract negotiation and renewals, in partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal and Security.

• Significant engineering leadership experience in SaaS, cloud platform, DevOps, developer experience, SRE or engineering productivity organisations.

  • A practical understanding of AI-assisted and agentic software development, ideally having led a team that builds AI agents or tooling for engineers, or a genuine drive to learn it fast.

  • Experience running engineering operations, with a track record of measuring productivity through outcomes rather than activity.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud cost management, vendor and contract management, and technical procurement.

  • Excellent communication and sound commercial judgement, with the ability to influence engineering, finance and executive stakeholders.

description:
Director, Product Management

Are you ready to shape the future of data?

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can't keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

We started in Manchester and now we're global - with teams across the UK, US and India and fifteen years of data expertise behind us. We have raised over $300M from some of the worlds' best investors, including General Atlantic, Lightspeed Venture Partners and Battery Ventures.

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We're here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we're looking for people who want to be part of it.

About the Role

As Director, Product Management, you'll own the strategy and execution for a core area of Matillion's product end to end. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll carry direct product ownership for a significant area while building and leading a team of Product Managers - roughly 40% of your time in direct product work, the rest on team leadership, stakeholder management and portfolio oversight, and that balance will shift over time.

Success in this role means category-level command of the data landscape, sharp product instincts, and the ability to raise the bar in others, not just in your own output.

You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design leadership to align on technical strategy, and with GTM, Customer Success and Marketing to keep the business ahead of what's shipping and turn what you learn into what you build next.

What you will be doing

  • Own a product area end to end: define the strategy for your area, translate company and product strategy into a multi-quarter roadmap, and make the prioritisation and resourcing trade-offs across multiple workstreams - with accountability for the commercial outcome of the whole portfolio.

  • Stay hands-on: retain direct ownership of a specific product area - write specs, run discovery, and make product calls yourself, not just through your team.

  • Set and enforce the quality bar: define what “good” looks like for the product area, review your team's product decisions and outputs, and hold the line with senior stakeholders when a capability isn't ready to ship - even when it's commercially uncomfortable.

  • Understand the market and the users: maintain a view of user needs across data engineering, analytics and platform personas, and own the competitive and market view of the data and AI ecosystem.

  • Build and lead the team: hire, coach and manage the performance of a team of Product Managers, run the team's operating rhythm, and set the standard for AI-enabled ways of working across the group.

  • Drive cross-functional and executive alignment: partner with Engineering and Design leadership on technical strategy and delivery capacity, keep GTM, Customer Success and Marketing ahead of what's shipping, and present roadmap and trade-offs to stakeholders, leadership and customers.

What we are looking for

  • Typically 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years managing Product Managers directly.

  • A track record of shipping and scaling B2B products end to end, with demonstrable commercial impact.

  • People leadership experience: you've hired, coached and managed the performance of Product Managers directly.

  • Real, hands-on exposure to the data ecosystem - enough to make credible technical trade-off calls.

  • A systems thinker operating at scale, balancing craft, speed and commercial impact across multiple workstreams at once.

  • Deep data literacy, and the ability to hold your team accountable to evidence-based decision-making.

  • A demonstrable track record of using AI tools to accelerate product work, and the ability to model, teach and hold your team to that same standard.

  • Excellent communication, including credibility in front of executive leadership and senior customers.

  • Comfortable holding a line under commercial pressure - on product quality and on team standards - and operating at both strategic and hands-on altitude in the same week.

At Matillion, we are committed to providing compensation in line with market standards based on the role, job family, job level and country. This role's estimated annual salaried pay range for this position is £108,320 - £162,480. The final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.

More about Matillion

We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:

  • Company Equity

  • 30 days holiday + bank holiday

  • 5 days paid volunteering leave

  • Private Health Insurance

  • Life Insurance

  • Pension

  • Access to mental health support

Your Safety

Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to matillion.com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion.com.

Want to know more?

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

Cannot find anything suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at talent@matillion.com.

Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here. 

Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

lists.content:
• 5+ years of full-cycle new-business sales experience in complex technology solution selling, with a consistent record of exceeding $1M+ ARR quotas and closing six-figure deals with net-new logos
  • Fluency in a sales methodology such as MEDDIC, Force Management, or Value Selling, and experience navigating enterprise contracts and RFP processes
  • A demonstrated hunter mentality: a track record of independently sourcing, developing, and closing new customers in greenfield or underpenetrated territory, with disciplined pipeline management
  • The ability to quickly translate technical challenges into a business value proposition that resonates at every level of a prospect's organization
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills, consistently meeting or exceeding new-business targets
    Domain expertise in the data and AI landscape strongly preferred; industry expertise in a relevant vertical is a plus
  • A scrappy, self-starter mindset, comfortable building without a fully paved path and willing to collaborate closely with a newer team as we establish how we win

• Own the full new-logo sales cycle — from self-generated pipeline through closing six-figure deals with net-new enterprise accounts
  • Build and execute a territory capture strategy in partnership with your SDR, marketing, and channel partners to maximize new customer acquisition
  • Develop relationships with technology and consulting partners, positioning Maia's value to open doors into new accounts
  • Partner cross-functionally with product, marketing, and solution architecture, continually sharpening your craft as a new-business hunter

Go straight to matillion.com/careers to verify open roles or reach us at talent@matillion.com.
 
 
Want to know more?
 
Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.

Cannot find a suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at talent@matillion.com.
Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here. 
 
 
Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Are you ready to shape the future of data?

lists.text: What we are looking for - Essential Skills:
lists.content:
• You will have at least 5 years of full-cycle sales experience in a complex technology solution-selling environment. You've consistently achieved and exceeded $1M+ ARR quotas and have a track record of sourcing and closing six-figure deals.
  • You're skilled in sales methodologies like MEDDIC, Force Management, or Value Selling, and you know how to navigate large enterprise software contracts and RFP processes.
  • You have a proven track record of independently sourcing, managing, developing, and onboarding new customers, demonstrating effective pipeline management
  • You can quickly uncover a customer's technical challenges and translate them into a clear business value proposition for all levels of their organization.
  • You have exceptional negotiation and closing skills with a consistent record of achieving or exceeding sales targets

• You'll be responsible for the entire sales process, from generating your own pipeline to closing six-figure deals and managing enterprise customers.
  • Develop a comprehensive strategy for your territory, collaborating with your SDR, marketing, and channel partners to maximize new customer acquisition and retention.
  • Foster strong relationships with technology and consulting partners, educating them on the value of Matillion to create new business opportunities.
  • Work cross-functionally with our product, marketing, and solution architecture teams, and maintain a growth mindset by continuously learning and applying new techniques to sharpen your skills.
